scenarios.title: Verify unified diff textbox is initially editable
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the unified diff text area accepts user input before the patch disables editing.

scenarios.title: Verify unified diff textbox updates on user input before patch
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that before the patch, typing in the unified diff textarea changes its value.

scenarios.title: Verify 'Clear diff' button is disabled when no diff present
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the clear diff button is disabled when the unified diff textarea is empty before the patch.

scenarios.title: Verify 'Clear diff' button is enabled when diff is present
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the clear diff button enables when there is text in the unified diff textarea before the patch.

scenarios.title: Verify placeholder text of unified diff textbox
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the placeholder instructs user on using the unified diff textbox, verifying unchanged text before patch.

steps.expected:
Paste a unified diff here, or enter a GitHub pull request URL above.

DiffSense will retrieve repository context before analyzing changed lines.
